# AGENTS.md — kube-kb

Kubebuilder v4 operator (Go 1.22) that reconciles a `KnowledgeBase` CRD (`kb.kubekb.io/v1alpha1`) to provision LLM inference + vector-DB + RAG infrastructure.

---

## Generated files — never edit directly

| File | Regenerated by |
|---|---|
| `api/v1alpha1/zz_generated.deepcopy.go` | `make generate` |
| `config/crd/bases/kb.kubekb.io_knowledgebases.yaml` | `make manifests` |
| `config/rbac/role.yaml` | `make manifests` |
| `PROJECT` | Kubebuilder tooling |

Kubebuilder marker comments in Go source (`// +kubebuilder:...`) drive all codegen. Edit the markers, then regenerate.

---

## Required command order after editing `api/v1alpha1/`

```bash
make generate    # rebuilds zz_generated.deepcopy.go
make manifests   # rebuilds CRD YAML and RBAC
make install     # applies updated CRDs to cluster (needed before make run/deploy)
```

`make build`, `make run`, and `make test` already depend on both `generate` and `manifests`, so calling them directly is safe but slower.

---

## Key developer commands

```bash
make fmt          # go fmt ./...
make vet          # go vet ./...
make lint         # golangci-lint v1.57.2 (downloaded to ./bin/)
make lint-fix     # auto-fix where possible
make build        # manifests → generate → fmt → vet → ./bin/manager
make run          # run controller locally against ~/.kube/config (no Docker)
make test         # downloads envtest binaries, runs all non-e2e tests, writes cover.out
make test-e2e     # full e2e suite (see requirements below)
make install      # apply CRDs to cluster
make deploy IMG=… # deploy operator into kube-kb-system namespace
make uninstall    # remove CRDs
make undeploy     # remove operator
```

All tool binaries (kustomize v5.4.1, controller-gen v0.21.0, golangci-lint v1.57.2, setup-envtest release-0.18) are downloaded into `./bin/` on first use and are gitignored.

---

## Running tests

### Unit / integration (envtest)

```bash
make test
# cover.out written to repo root
```

`make test` sets `KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS` automatically. Running `go test` directly without it fails (envtest needs real API server + etcd binaries at `./bin/k8s/1.30.0-<os>-<arch>/`).

To run a focused subset after envtest binaries are already present:

```bash
KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS="$(./bin/setup-envtest use 1.30.0 --bin-dir ./bin -p path)" \
  go test ./internal/controller/... -v -run TestControllers
```

Tests use Ginkgo v2 + Gomega. The suite reads CRD YAML from `../../config/crd/bases/` (relative to the test file), so `make manifests` must have been run first.

### End-to-end tests

Requires: running Kind cluster, `kubectl` and `kind` on PATH, Docker.

```bash
make test-e2e   # go test ./test/e2e/ -v -ginkgo.v
```

The suite installs Prometheus Operator v0.72.0 and cert-manager v1.14.4, builds the image (`example.com/kube-kb:v0.0.1`), loads it into Kind, then deploys/undeploys the full operator. `KIND_CLUSTER` env var overrides the cluster name (default: `kind`).

---

## Important constraints

- **Never write `.spec` from the reconciler** — the status subresource is enabled; only `.status` is writable by the controller.
- **License header required on all new Go files.** Use the Apache 2.0 header in `hack/boilerplate.go.txt` (year: 2026). controller-gen adds it automatically; add it manually for handwritten files.
- **`revive` linter enforces `comment-spacings`** — all `//` comments must have a space after `//`.
- **`lll` line-length check is disabled** inside `api/*` and `internal/*` but active elsewhere.
- **Do not create `go.work`** — this is a single-module repo; a workspace file is gitignored and should not exist.
- **Dockerfile copies only `cmd/`, `api/`, `internal/controller/`** — adding new top-level packages requires updating the Dockerfile `COPY` directives.

---

## Architecture quick-reference

```
cmd/main.go                          # Manager entrypoint
api/v1alpha1/knowledgebase_types.go  # CRD schema (edit here for new fields)
internal/controller/knowledgebase_controller.go  # Reconcile loop
config/samples/kb_v1alpha1_knowledgebase.yaml    # Example CR (note: sample still has stale scaffold field spec.foo)
poc/ingestor/ingest.py               # Python PoC pipeline (LangChain + pgvector + Ollama)
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md                 # Component diagram and provider design
```

- Operator namespace: `kube-kb-system`
- CRD group/version: `kb.kubekb.io/v1alpha1`, kind: `KnowledgeBase`
- Leader election ID: `80bd0512.kubekb.io`
- Metrics endpoint is secured by default (`--metrics-secure=true`; requires AuthN/AuthZ)
- HTTP2 is explicitly disabled in the manager (CVE mitigations)

---

## PoC ingestion pipeline (Python)

```bash
cd poc && docker-compose up -d          # starts pgvector (pg16)
pip install -r poc/requirements.txt     # Python 3.10+ required (uses str | None syntax)
python poc/ingestor/ingest.py           # reads poc/config.yaml
GITHUB_TOKEN=<token> python poc/ingestor/ingest.py  # for private repos
```

`poc/ollama/` and `poc/retriever/` are empty stubs — not yet implemented.
